title: Electromechanical Equipment Assemblers
description: Assemble or modify electromechanical equipment or devices, such as servomechanisms, gyros, dynamometers, magnetic drums, tape drives, brakes, control linkage, actuators, and appliances.

tasks.text: Inspect, test, and adjust completed units to ensure that units meet specifications, tolerances, and customer order requirements.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installed assembly inspection needs physical access

tasks.text: Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Assemble parts or units, and position, align, and fasten units to assemblies, subassemblies, or frames, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Connect cables, tubes, and wiring, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting supply lines is physical fitting

dwas.name: Connect supply lines to production equipment or tools.

tasks.text: Measure parts to determine tolerances, using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and verniers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Read blueprints and specifications to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprints need spatial reading, human verifies sequence

dwas.name: Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Attach name plates and mark identifying information on parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Disassemble units to replace parts or to crate them for shipping.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: File, lap, and buff parts to fit, using hand and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reshaping metal requires hands-on machining

dwas.name: Reshape metal workpieces to established specifications.

tasks.text: Clean and lubricate parts and subassemblies, using grease paddles or oilcans.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of lubricants to workpieces

dwas.name: Apply lubricants or coolants to workpieces.

tasks.text: Operate or tend automated assembling equipment, such as robotics and fixed automation equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on control of industrial machinery in unstructured settings

tasks.text: Drill, tap, ream, countersink, and spot-face bolt holes in parts, using drill presses and portable power drills.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Operate small cranes to transport or position large parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Pack or fold insulation between panels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electromechanical assembly requires hands-on fitting
